message.guildmark.trade.board.bare: This board stands in no capital: there is no town's word to chalk on it.
gui.guildmark.trade.board.title: Haul Board
gui.guildmark.trade.board.slate.empty: Nothing is chalked yet: no word has come in from another capital.
gui.guildmark.trade.board.slate.off: The Word is off: the slate is bare.
gui.guildmark.trade.board.by: Brought by %s, and chalked from their report
gui.guildmark.trade.board.here.tip: The tickets %s has out, as they stand this moment.
gui.guildmark.trade.board.here.title: Tickets of %s
gui.guildmark.trade.board.here.none: No tickets are up: the town wants nothing from the road just now.
gui.guildmark.trade.board.heard.title: %s, as the board heard it
gui.guildmark.trade.board.heard.none: %s had no tickets out when its word left it.
gui.guildmark.trade.board.book.tip: Booked as the shop's counter books it: a deposit of %1$s is held and paid back as you bring the goods in. Due in %2$s.
gui.guildmark.trade.board.book.heard.tip: As the town last had it. Book checks it against the town itself now: if it's gone, nothing is taken.
gui.guildmark.trade.board.foot.notally: You carry no Tally: what you read here is not kept.
gui.guildmark.trade.board.foot.copied: Read into your Tally: %s of its towns are newer now.
gui.guildmark.trade.board.foot.copied.on: Read into your Tally: one of its towns is newer now.
gui.guildmark.trade.board.foot.kept: Your Tally has all of this already.
gui.guildmark.trade.board.seal.tip: A ticket you book is stamped again in this colour, on the board and on its screen.
